name: catalyst_final_capability_contract_matrix_v1
purpose: One machine-readable matrix covering direction, scenario, exact common metrics, the unique authoritative external baseline, support boundary, minimal allowed adaptation, current evidence/status, and the next scientifically valid gap.

global_rules.target: Match/exceed the unique baseline capability-by-capability and establish >5pp gains on multiple independent, predeclared directions without hiding difficult slices.

e2r_sequence_divergent_known_reaction_na.scenario: Official ReactZyme enzyme-similarity native split; sequence-divergent/mostly unseen enzymes mapped to train-seen reactions.
e2r_sequence_divergent_known_reaction_na.support: 8,734 unique test proteins x 1,573 test reactions; 8,739 positives; byte-identical official ReactZyme enzyme_smi_split archive.
allowed_adaptation: support identity normalization fixed before performance
forbidden_adaptation: Catalyst-specific extra labels for the baseline
e2r_sequence_divergent_known_reaction_na.claim_boundary: Not reaction-novel evidence: all 1,573 test reactions are train-seen. Public split contains three exact train/test sequences; removing them changes MAP negligibly.

r2e_sequence_divergent_known_reaction_na.scenario: Official ReactZyme enzyme-similarity native split; train-seen reaction queries retrieve sequence-divergent/mostly unseen enzymes.
r2e_sequence_divergent_known_reaction_na.support: 1,573 test reactions x 8,734 unique test proteins; 8,739 positives; byte-identical official archive.
allowed_adaptation: support identity normalization fixed before performance
forbidden_adaptation: Catalyst-specific extra labels for the baseline
r2e_sequence_divergent_known_reaction_na.claim_boundary: Known-reaction retrieval only; all 1,573 reaction queries are train-seen. Top5 gain is +2.25pp, so do not call every metric a >5pp breakthrough.

r2e_structure_available.support: Exactly reconstructed 99-query common Enzyme-405 support for retained author metrics.
r2e_structure_available.claim_boundary: CAGE MRR/MAP/AUROC/NDCG remain N/A because raw historical CAGE rows are unavailable.

r2e_native_molecule_bag.scenario: Native unordered molecule-bag input requiring executable author-compatible molecular encoding.
r2e_native_molecule_bag.support: Common executable native molecular support fixed by input/mapping availability only.
r2e_native_molecule_bag.claim_boundary: Current Catalyst molecule-bag adapter is an input-coverage/retention result, not proof of superiority over ReactZyme.

r2e_true_reaction_novel.scenario: Reaction query is genuinely novel relative to association training; difficult low-reaction-similarity cases must remain explicit.
r2e_true_reaction_novel.current_catalyst_evidence: Fresh salted internal bounded-center V3 confirmation improves the <0.3 reaction-similarity slice, but this does not replace an external baseline.
r2e_true_reaction_novel.next_action: Run only the already-frozen single Catalyst DualTowerNative recipe on official train positives, then score native support once for descriptive TIGER alignment. No promotion or retuning is allowed on this already revealed split.
r2e_true_reaction_novel.support: Exact native support: 14,688 test proteins x 386 unseen test reactions; 14,689 unique positive label cells.
r2e_true_reaction_novel.claim_boundary: True reaction-novel native benchmark. TIGER is paper-only and cannot yet serve as executable backstop; CLIPZyme remains an executable reference but not the authoritative baseline.

e2r_true_reaction_novel.scenario: Enzyme query must identify genuinely novel reactions rather than only train-seen reaction classes.
e2r_true_reaction_novel.next_action: Run only the already-frozen single Catalyst DualTowerNative recipe on official train positives, then score native support once for descriptive TIGER alignment. No promotion or retuning is allowed on this already revealed split.
e2r_true_reaction_novel.support: Exact native support: 14,688 test proteins x 386 unseen test reactions; 14,689 unique positive label cells.
e2r_true_reaction_novel.claim_boundary: True reaction-novel native benchmark. TIGER is paper-only and cannot yet serve as executable backstop; CLIPZyme remains an executable reference but not the authoritative baseline.
